$comment: The Scribe's Discord configuration (functions/lib/discord.ts reads it; bundled at build).

Every id is a Discord snowflake (17 to 20 digits). A value that is not one, such as the REPLACE_WITH_ placeholders below, is ignored, so the Scribe works without a channel or a ping until it is filled in.

roles: role id -> { rank, office, precedence }. A member's code fills in the rank of their highest-precedence mapped role. A member with no mapped role is not issued a code and may file only Applications and Public Requests.
summons: who is pinged. command = Strategic (the Justiciars and the department heads); all = Cataclysm (every member and High Command).
channels: the archive channel each category posts to. The Clerk's verdict on an Application or Public Request is posted to that category's channel too.
List the server's roles and channels with: node scripts/discord-setup.mjs roles
